name: codex-task-control-plane
description: Control user-visible Codex tasks with native task tools, durable state, controller decisions, and optional Codex Activity Oversight (CAO) state control.
keywords: スレッドオーケストレーション

interface.shortDescription: Control visible Codex tasks with durable state
interface.longDescription: Create, observe, continue, fork, hand off, organize, and review user-visible Codex tasks through the native Codex task-tool family. Keep project resolution, task addresses, operation intents, results, controller decisions, and optional Codex Activity Oversight state-control boundaries in an atomic local ledger.
defaultPrompt: Create a dry-run task-control plan for this project.
Use 上位管制 to coordinate visible Codex tasks and retain their task IDs.
Activate optional Codex Activity Oversight state control for a visible task.
